reviews.title: Best habit tracker
reviews.text:
I've tried a lot of habit trackers, and Habitify is by far my favorite. The app is clean, easy to use, and has just the right amount of customization without feeling overwhelming. One of my favorite features is the Fitbit integration, which automatically logs habits like steps and sleep. It saves time and makes habit tracking much more accurate.

The only feature I'd love to see is an option to disable the auto-log notifications while keeping reminder notifications enabled. Right now, the auto-log notifications can clutter my notification center, so having a separate toggle would make the experience even better.

Overall, Habitify has been an amazing app, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking to build better habits.

reviews.title: Buggy and no support
reviews.text:
I tried this app for a day during the trial period and liked it enough to purchase a one-year subscription. Unfortunately, shortly after subscribing, the app became unstable.

It frequently logs me out, the widgets have never worked (they appear blank), and Apple Health syncing stopped working after the first day. I contacted support and initially received a quick response with some follow-up questions, but after providing the requested information, I never received a solution or any further assistance.

I tried reinstalling the app multiple times, but the issues persisted. Out of frustration, I canceled my subscription and requested a refund. My refund request was denied.

As a result, I paid for a subscription to an app that does not function properly, received no resolution for the problems I reported, and was then denied a refund. This has been a very disappointing customer experience.

reviews.title: Needs more control over settings
reviews.text:
I’ve been a user for years. The newest update that nags me every time I try to mark a habit as failed for the day (pop up: “Are you sure the day is over?” with a comment box) is annoying and infantilizing. Yes, I am sure the day is over. I’m doing my daily cleanup. Leave me alone! Let me turn this feature off, PLEASE. May need to find a new app otherwise. I’m not expecting perfection from every habit, every day, and I don’t need the guilt trip from the app about that.

Edited to add: I do see that the developer usually responds to reviews, which I appreciate. But I am not open to submitting a feature request or sending screen recordings. You already know how the feature works; your PM (or someone) chose not to prioritize building an off switch for it despite it being a predictably disruptive feature. Shipping annoying stuff without an off switch is a churn risk, and I shouldn’t need to find an issue to upvote to tell you that.
